mapper.select: SELECT * FROM b_marketing_customer order by sort desc;

SELECT t1.* FROM b_marketing_customer t1 inner join (select api_code, row_number() over (partition by api_code order by create_time) as num from b_marketing_sync_info where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 day)) t2 on t1.api_code = t2.api_code and t2.num = 1 order by t1.sort desc;
